narrativeProgression.description: Instructor selects the Ellipse Tool in Adobe Illustrator.
Draws a thin, elongated ellipse, emphasizing sharp points at each end.
Changes the fill color to black and removes the stroke.
Locks the layer containing the ellipse.
Creates a new Art Brush from the selected ellipse.
Demonstrates the newly created brush, showcasing its sharp points.
Adjusts the smoothness of the brush for a more refined appearance.
Shows how to change the size of the brush.
